configuration.sample_policy: one complete cold encode and one archive-only decode; no size/time selection among repetitions

exposure: Silesia is an established/repeated benchmark in this private project; not a fresh holdout. All 12 named members and canonical source SHA-256s are predeclared.
hypothesis: Produce one complete, byte-exact, same-run seven-method comparison for every original Silesia member at each declared speed/current/size preset.
initial_state: empty encoder/decoder for every independent file; all route decisions/framing charged in archive size.
matched_control: same complete official member SHA-256; one-core host and same 2 GB memory/100 MB temp/300 s phase caps; no cross-file state.
mechanism: CIX complete adaptive portfolio archive, or direct original-byte reference codec archive; all selected archives are independently decoded with the original source and its materialized copy inaccessible to the decoder.
promotion_criteria: Complete physical archive; decode uses archive plus pinned decoder/dependency policy only; exact length and SHA-256 restoration; incomplete/time/resource cases remain unranked.
resource_accounting: One physical core; systemd cgroup MemoryMax 2,000,000,000; MemorySwapMax 0; work directory cap 100,000,000; phase wall max 300 seconds; aggregate 4 cores / 12 GB / 4 GB temp.
